name: loop_slice_corner
description: Loop Slice with Slice Selected ON, over an L-SHAPED face selection -- the gesture the chapter performs repeatedly (a band of polygons that turns a corner). PARITY as of task 1054 Phase 3 (the selection-band walk, doc/loop_slice_corner_plan.md): the cut turns at the corner cell -- entering through one edge and leaving through a PERPENDICULAR one -- exactly matching the reference. Until task 1054 this fixture recorded a KNOWN DIVERGENCE (measured 2026-08-16, task 1053): vibe3d used to clip both rings to the selection independently, so they crossed inside the corner cell and produced three extra vertices the reference does not. This same measurement -- case `L` of the 54-case band-walk corpus -- is reproduced verbatim by the parity fixture `loop_slice_band.json`; this file is kept as the task's own named deliverable and provenance record.
source: LIVE-CAPTURED from the reference editor, driven headlessly through its command line. A 3x1x3 box, the top face's 3x3 grid, an L of five cells selected by centroid predicate (the row at z=-1/3 plus the column at x=+1/3), then its loop-slice tool with the slice-selected option on and a count of one, applied through the tool-apply command. Base and result were both dumped; the reference's answer is 38 verts / 71 edges / 35 polys against a 32/60/30 base. Three different values of its current-edge attribute were captured separately and produced identical geometry, so the ring is derived from the selection, not from that attribute.

provenance.notes: No dedicated schema enum for a headless command-port capture; 'capture-drag' stands in per the loop_slice family's established convention (doc/golden_provenance_manifest.md). The tool APPLIES headlessly -- set the tool, set its attributes, apply, drop it: no viewport gesture and no pointer injection, which the 0263 capture note had recorded as needing an interactive commit. So the drag-transport artifact does not apply to this measurement. Flipped from known-divergence to parity by task 1054 Phase 3 (the selection-band walk) -- see doc/loop_slice_corner_plan.md.
